decisions.reason: As a very recent launch in a core application area, the loader should be kept on the market because uncertainty about demand and fit is still high, the firm can support it with existing mining engineering and service capabilities, and there is no clear negative signal yet that would justify abandoning the option.

The dump truck also appears worth keeping because after only one year the firm has learned too little to close this option, while it fits closely with the company's underground mining portfolio and can be maintained using shared technology, sales channels and after-sales support.
